name: B.L.U.E.
description:
About This Game

Demo Disclaimer: 

Please note that the B.L.U.E. demo is an early proof of concept and technical vertical slice intended to showcase the game's core vision and shipbuilding/combat systems. It is not representative of the final product. Features, content, performance, balance, visuals, and overall gameplay are still in development and may change significantly before Early Access and full release. Thank you for playing and supporting B.L.U.E. as development continues!

What is B.L.U.E.?

B.L.U.E. is a space combat and ship-building game built on real-world physics and aerospace engineering principles. Created by and for engineers and sci-fi enthusiasts, B.L.U.E. lets you build, launch, upgrade, and evolve alongside your friends as you design powerful spacecraft, face reality-bending anomalies, and battle in explosive, physics-driven combat.

Drawing inspiration from roguelikes, MOBAs, hero shooters, and buildcrafting games, B.L.U.E. combines in-depth ship customization with objective-based combat and evolving in-match builds. Every component you add can change how your ship flies, fights, and functions, while objectives and rewards give you opportunities to upgrade and evolve your build as the battle progresses.

>>> BUILD <<<

Create a near infinite range of starship designs within a complex, modular ship-building system. Manage power and heat, stockpile drones and ordnance, and mount powerful weapons to build a ship that fits your play style.

>>> LAUNCH <<<

Enter epic arenas carved into grand cosmic architectures. Test your ship designs in the fire of combat by eliminating other interlopers, completing anomaly objectives, and adapting your build on the fly as the battlefield evolves and the tides of combat shift. Only the ingenious will survive.

>>> UPGRADE <<<

Iterate and refine your ship designs as the battlefield unravels. Unlock new parts, install advanced modules, and enhance your ship's systems as you converge upon increasingly optimized designs.

>>> EVOLVE <<<

Uncover advanced technologies within the remnants of anomalies and battlefield debris. Transform your ship parts, augment your play style with new abilities, and push your designs beyond their limits, unlocking entirely new combat capabilities.
short_desc: B.L.U.E. (Build, Launch, Upgrade, Evolve) is a sci-fi shipbuilding and combat simulator where you design customized spacecraft from modular components. Iterate and refine your ship design as you battle other interlopers in explosive, physics-driven PvP battles.
